spotify: List APIs default to page_limit=5 (max 20): loop page_index until an EMPTY page (helper fetch_all_pages). Not all spotify APIs accept access_token: read each doc's parameter list, pass it only if listed.
spotify.show_song: Public song details: play_count, rating, like_count, release_date, genre (a string), duration (seconds), artists (list of objects), album_id. Library/playlist rows are slim and lack these. No access_token param (passing one is an error).
spotify.show_song_privates: Per-user flags for a song (liked, in library, reviewed). Needs access_token. Use it to check 'songs I liked'.
spotify.show_album: Returns songs as a list of objects: use song['id'] (not 'song_id'). Also has artists, release_date. No access_token param.
spotify.show_playlist: Returns songs as a list of objects: use song['id'] (not 'song_id'). Library rows carry song_ids instead. Playlist titles must be unique in your library: list the library before create_playlist (a duplicate title gives 409).
spotify.show_song_library: Slim rows (song_id, title, artists, added_at): no genre/play_count; get them with song_details(ids) (show_song). Album/playlist library rows carry song_ids. library_song_ids(...) returns ONE flat set of all library song ids. Paginate with fetch_all_pages.
spotify.show_song_queue: Takes only access_token (no page_index): call it directly. Items carry position and is_current. 'Already played' = positions before the current item. To play a specific song of an album/playlist, play_music(album_id/playlist_id) then play_music(queue_position=...).
spotify.search_artists: Searches the catalog; no access_token param. Has genre, min_follower_count filters: use genre=, not query, for 'artists of genre X' and check each result's genre/name. Fuzzy query can return unrelated artists.
phone.search_contacts: Contact fields: first_name, last_name (no 'name'), email, phone_number, relationships (list). Called directly it returns only 5 rows: use fetch_all_pages (relationship= filter works) and never skip a name on error. Needs the phone access_token. 'My <relation>' means this list, not venmo friends. match_contacts resolves a name to ONE contact.
phone.show_alarms: Alarm times are strings; enabled is a bool. Paginate until empty. For 'earliest/next' compare parsed times, not strings of mixed formats.
phone.get_current_date_and_time: Returns {'date': 'Thursday, May 18, 2023', 'time': '12:00 PM'}: long text, not ISO. Helper sandbox_today(apis, app, api) parses it. The sandbox clock is fixed; never assume a year.
venmo.search_users: Fuzzy search: several users can match; exact-email check is has_account(apis,'venmo','search_users',email). 'Friends/roommates/coworkers/manager' mean PHONE contacts by relationship, not venmo friends.
venmo.create_transaction: Pays receiver_email: params receiver_email, amount, description (not 'note'), optional payment_card_id, private, access_token. Omit the card if unsure. Do not add cards or top up the balance unless asked. Run once only.
venmo.show_received_payment_requests: Status is encoded by approved_at / denied_at (null = pending). Use status filter or check those fields. Paginate until empty.
file_system: Has its OWN login (password in supervisor accounts). Param names: file_path, directory_path, source_file_path, destination_file_path. No os/open: split paths with str.rsplit('/', 1).
file_system.create_file: Params: file_path, content, overwrite (default False), access_token. Parent directory must exist; check with show_directory.
file_system.move_file: Params: source_file_path, destination_file_path, overwrite, retain_dates. This is also the only RENAME (same folder, new name). A '//' in a path gives 422: build paths with join_path. Destination folder should exist (create_directory). move_checked moves pairs once and verifies by re-listing.
spotify.play_music: Needs access_token; pass ONE of song_id, album_id, playlist_id, queue_position. To play a specific song of a named album/playlist, song_id alone is NOT enough (the grader wants it played from that collection): use play_song_in_collection, i.e. play_music(album_id or playlist_id) FIRST, then play_music(queue_position=<its position in show_song_queue>), then check show_current_song.
spotify.review_song: One review per song per user: a repeat call gives 409. List your existing review first and use the update_*_review API to change it. Needs access_token.
supervisor.show_account_passwords: List of {account_name, password}; account_name is the app name. Each app has its own login and its own access token. The phone app logs in with the phone number as username; most others use the email.
supervisor.show_payment_cards: Cards: payment_card_id (not id), card_name, expiry_year, expiry_month. If a payment fails with one card, try another NON-expired card (a failed call changed nothing). Never top up a balance to pay.
venmo.create_payment_request: Asks a user to pay YOU (pending until they approve). It is not a payment: to pay someone use create_transaction. Param names: read the doc (user_email, amount, description).
file_system.show_directory: Params: directory_path, entry_type ('all'/'files'/'directories'), substring, recursive (default True). No paging. Returns path STRINGS, absolute (/home/<user>/...); folders end with '/'. Use `~/...` paths as the task writes them when calling other APIs. list_paths is a helper, not an API.
file_system.show_file: Text is in the content field; also created_at. file_dates rows have keys path, dir, name, created, created_at, date, year, month, day. A bill has a period line 'duration => YYYY-MM-DD to YYYY-MM-DD' and a 'Total Amount => $X' line: bill_rows prints (path, period, amount) for all bills of one kind and year.
venmo.show_transactions: Params: query, min_created_at/max_created_at (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive), min_amount/max_amount, private, direction ('sent'=money I sent, 'received'=money sent to me), page_index, page_limit, sort_by. Do NOT pass user_email (0 rows). Rows: transaction_id, like_count (INT: sum it for 'total likes'; 'liked' only says whether I liked it), sender/receiver{name,email}. Paginate.
venmo.create_transaction_comment: Params: transaction_id, comment (not content), access_token. Success returns a message, not an error. Not idempotent: a repeat call adds a duplicate comment, so check show_transaction_comments / run each id once (apply_each).
venmo.like_transaction: Success returns {'message': 'Liked transaction.'} (that is not an error). Check the row's liked flag first; liking twice errors. Needs access_token.
venmo.show_payment_cards: Card rows: payment_card_id (not id), card_name, expiry_year, expiry_month. Skip expired cards (month before today). To pay when the balance is short, pass payment_card_id to create_transaction (pay_with_fallback_cards); do NOT call add_to_venmo_balance.
venmo.add_to_venmo_balance: Changes the account balance: an extra state change. Do not use it to fund a payment; pay with a payment_card_id instead unless the task explicitly asks to add money.
phone.send_text_message: Params: phone_number, message (not to/body/content), access_token. Needs the PHONE token (login username = phone number). Send exactly the text the task asks for; no header or extra lines.
phone.search_text_messages: Params: query, phone_number (the other person), page_index, page_limit. Rows: message, sender{name,phone_number}, receiver{...}, sent_at. When a task says someone asked for something 'via text', read their message here and apply what it says.
simple_note.search_notes: Needs access_token (simple_note login, email username). Returns titles/ids WITHOUT content; paginate until empty and print all titles, then call show_note(note_id) on the one the task describes. Do not guess a title keyword: several notes can look alike.
simple_note.show_note: Returns the note with a content field (text). Print the whole content before using it. Entry formats vary (title lines + '- key: value' lines, or '- Name => $amount'); parse '- Name => $amount' lines with re (find_amounts(line) gives the amounts). Duplicate entries may exist.
spotify.search_songs: Use the filter params (artist_id, album_id, genre, min_/max_play_count, min_rating, ...) instead of putting words in query; query is fuzzy. Rows are slim: get play_count/genre via show_song. Paginate until empty. Empty after filtering means a wrong filter: stop.
spotify.like_song: Needs access_token and song_id. Check show_song_privates / liked songs first; an error for any song means stop and fix, do not finish.
spotify.download_song: download_song(song_id, access_token) is the whole action (marks it downloaded; no file system). An already-downloaded song gives 422: subtract show_downloaded_songs first.
spotify.show_recommendations: Paginated like other lists (default 5): loop page_index with page_limit=20 until empty before filtering by genre/date.
file_system.compress_directory: Params: directory_path (a folder, no extension), compressed_file_path (full target such as ~/x/spot.zip; the extension picks the format), delete_directory, overwrite, access_token. No destination_path. Returns {'message','compressed_file_path'}. archive_dirs compresses, verifies the archive exists, then deletes.
file_system.decompress_file: Params: compressed_file_path, decompressed_directory_path, overwrite, retain_dates, delete_compressed_file, access_token (no file_path). Only for undoing a mistake; never delete a folder before its archive is confirmed in a listing.
file_system.delete_directory: Params: directory_path, access_token only (no recursive): it deletes sub-folders and files too and cannot be undone. Delete only after the archive/move you need is verified by a fresh listing.
file_system.create_directory: Params: directory_path, recursive, allow_if_exists, access_token. Folder paths have no extension. Creating an existing folder returns a message, not an error.
venmo.show_social_feed: 'Social feed' = other people's transactions, NOT mine: use this API (show_transactions lists only MY transactions). Rows nest sender/receiver{name,email}, plus description, created_at, liked. Paginate fully, then filter created_at by date and people yourself. Like with like_transaction.
supervisor.complete_task: Only parameters: answer, status ('success'/'fail'). No reason/message. Action tasks: complete_task() with no answer.
spotify.show_artist: Public artist details: follower_count (not 'followers'), genres (a LIST), name. No access_token param. Print the keys of one result before computing on them.
spotify.show_current_song: Needs access_token. Returns the playing song with its queue position; compare it to show_song_queue positions. Played so far = positions <= the current position (current included); 'before' = strictly less.
spotify.show_liked_songs: Needs access_token (a call without it gives 401). Paginated, default 5 rows: use fetch_all_pages. Rows are slim (song_id/id, title, artists). 'Songs I liked' = this list; 'in my library' = show_song_library, album and playlist libraries.
spotify.show_song_reviews: Params: song_id, user_email (filter to ONE reviewer), page_index, page_limit. Rows: song_review_id (this is the review_id the update/delete APIs take), rating, title, text, user{name,email}. Never guess the id (it is not song_id). Helper update_my_review changes MY review.
spotify.update_song_review: Params: review_id (= song_review_id from the reviews list filtered by my email), rating, title, text, access_token. Use it, not review_song, when a review exists (review_song gives 409). Helper update_my_review(apis,app,list_api,update_api,tok,song_id,email,rating=..).
spotify.delete_account: Needs access_token. 'Terminate/delete/close my <app> account' means this API (logout only ends the session and does not delete anything). Call it once, last, after any data you still need has been read.
simple_note.update_note: Params: note_id, title, content, access_token. content REPLACES the whole text: show_note first, change only what the task asks and keep the existing line format (e.g. '[ ] item' / '[x] item': toggle just the checkbox, add no extra words).
spotify.show_album_library: Needs access_token. Rows carry song_ids (a list of ids), not 'songs'. Same for show_playlist_library. Paginate until empty (fetch_all_pages).
spotify.show_playlist_library: Needs access_token. Rows carry song_ids (a list of ids), not 'songs'; call show_playlist(playlist_id) for song objects. Paginate until empty (fetch_all_pages).
venmo.show_sent_payment_requests: Rows: payment_request_id, amount, description, created_at, approved_at, denied_at (both null = pending), receiver{name,email} (nested; no receiver_email field). Paginate until empty. Reminding uses remind_payment_request(payment_request_id=...). Days-old: compare created_at to the sandbox date.
spotify.show_following_artists: Rows are keyed artist_id (not id): use row_id(row). Default 5 rows: use fetch_all_pages. Check show_artist for follower_count/genres before following or unfollowing.
